name: escalation-summarizer
description: Turns a messy escalation thread you paste (ticket comments, a chat or email chain, internal notes) into what the person it is escalated to needs: a one-paragraph summary, the explicit ask (what is needed from them, by when) and the customer impact, only as the thread states it. Every statement is backed by a verbatim quote from the thread, checked in code; a missing ask or impact is shown as missing, never guessed. Follow-ups: show sources, only the ask, shorter, for a given audience (the VP, the CEO), who said the deadline, as json, or a question about the thread. It does not reply to the customer, assign blame or recommend a fix, and reads only what you paste.

skills.name: Summarize an escalation
skills.description: A summary paragraph, the explicit ask and the stated customer impact of the escalation thread you paste, each backed by quotes from that thread, plus follow-ups on the same thread.
examples: Summarize this escalation for the VP: <paste the thread>
